metadata.venue: MetLife Stadium, East Rutherford, New Jersey

ai_summary.key_headline: Group E Power Clash: Elephants' Physical Dominance Meets La Tri's High-Altitude Pace

ivory_coast.philosophy: Physical, direct wing play using Franck Kessié to boss the midfield and launch counters.

ecuador.philosophy: High intensity press, rapid transition down the flanks through Enner Valencia and Moisés Caicedo.

tactical_insights: Ivory Coast will try to exploit set-pieces and physical matchups in the box.
Ecuador's speed on transition poses a massive threat to the older Ivorian center-backs.
The midfield battle between Moisés Caicedo and Franck Kessié will decide possession dominance.
